name: SP.POP.TOTL
label: Population, total
population: All residents under the de facto population definition, regardless of legal status or citizenship.

measurement.definition: Total de facto resident population represented as a midyear estimate.
measurement.construction_notes: The indicator metadata identifies UN population estimates, national statistical offices, Eurostat, and UN statistical publications as upstream sources; exact construction can vary by economy and vintage.

comparability.notes: WDI seeks cross-country comparability, but its own methodological guidance states that full cross-country and intertemporal comparability cannot be assured.

verification.notes: Indicator code, label, definition, WDI membership, and upstream source organizations checked through the official API. Country-vintage methods and availability remain unresolved.
